inheritanceRule: Every omitted field inherits the resolved parent class value.

profiles.name: Scaled Fist

constraints.summary: A draconic exemplar and associated dragon type shape several class features.

evidence.reason: The Monk eventually gains a scaling elemental breath weapon.

profiles.playerSummary: A Charisma-driven draconic Monk whose chosen exemplar grants claws, elemental damage, fear resistance and a breath weapon.
profiles.tradeoff: Its draconic choice fixes several later benefits and shifts key class abilities toward Charisma.

profiles.name: Elemental Monk

constraints.summary: The Monk must have a neutral component to alignment rather than follow the normal lawful restriction.

evidence.reason: Elemental damage and later genie spell-like powers become recurring combat tools.

profiles.playerSummary: An element-aligned Monk who cycles elemental strikes and develops supernatural techniques inspired by genies.
profiles.tradeoff: The elemental progression replaces several traditional ki and defensive features and imposes a different alignment requirement.

profiles.name: Gunpowder Bombardier

evidence.reason: Scaling explosives create bursts, impair targets and can be planted with delayed detonation.

profiles.playerSummary: A Ninja who turns ki into thrown or planted explosives with configurable damage types and impairments.
profiles.tradeoff: A meaningful share of ninja tricks is committed to a limited explosive resource.

profiles.name: Petal Ninja

evidence.reason: Petal clouds obscure areas and impose sensory or movement-related effects.

profiles.playerSummary: A floral Ninja who creates showers and bursts of blossoms to obscure, distract and hinder groups.
profiles.tradeoff: Several standard ninja tricks are replaced by conspicuous plant-themed area effects.

profiles.name: Battle Host

constraints.summary: A chosen weapon, armour or shield becomes the sole implement and central panoply bond.

evidence.reason: Full martial progression, combat feats and a spirit warrior centre the Occultist on battle.

profiles.playerSummary: A martial Occultist whose entire implement practice is bound into one weapon, suit of armour or shield.
profiles.tradeoff: The single bonded panoply sharply narrows implement freedom and makes equipment loss especially costly.

profiles.name: Silksworn
profiles.sourceCitationText: Heroes of the High Court pg. 29

evidence.reason: Courtly clothing implements provide strong social and deceptive powers.

profiles.playerSummary: A courtly Occultist who carries a larger magical repertoire through expensive clothing and jewellery.
profiles.tradeoff: Martial armour and weapon competence are exchanged for socially powerful but gear-dependent mysticism.

profiles.name: Pei Zin Practitioner

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The archetype explicitly practises herbal medicine and delivers scaling treatment and condition removal.

evidence.reason: Lay-on-hands-style healing and advanced condition treatment become defining revelations.

profiles.playerSummary: An Oracle trained as a professional herbal healer, combining divine magic with efficient hands-on treatment and condition removal.
profiles.tradeoff: The mystery’s normal skill package and several revelations are committed to healing practice.

profiles.name: Warsighted

evidence.reason: Repeated access to temporary combat feats makes martial adaptation a central Oracle feature.

profiles.playerSummary: An Oracle who exchanges several revelations for Brawler-style martial flexibility across melee and ranged builds.
profiles.tradeoff: Its combat strength depends on knowing a large feat catalogue and choosing the right temporary feat.

profiles.name: Hospitaler

evidence.section: Channel Positive Energy / Aura of Healing
evidence.reason: Independent channel uses and a stabilising, cleansing healing aura make group protection central.

profiles.playerSummary: A Paladin who sacrifices smite frequency to become a stronger battlefield healer and protector of afflicted allies.
profiles.tradeoff: Smite Evil advances at roughly half the normal frequency and Aura of Justice is lost.

profiles.name: Holy Gun

constraints.summary: Divine bond must take the form of a firearm.

evidence.reason: Smite damage, grit deeds and divine bond are delivered through firearms.

profiles.playerSummary: A firearm Paladin who spends grit on devastating smiting shots and bonds permanently with a gun.
profiles.tradeoff: Heavy armour and ordinary melee-centred smite are replaced by a costly, resource-driven firearm style.
